title: Permit and Inspection Status
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:inspection
| stats latest(status) as status, latest(_time) as updated by permit
| eval stale_days=round((now()-updated)/86400,1)
| sort - stale_days
description: Keeps every permit and inspection with its latest status so no legal step is missed before work continues.
value: Skipping a required inspection can mean expensive rework or fines; a status board prevents that.
implementation: Ingest permit and inspection records into `index=personal`; track latest status per permit.
visualization: Table of permits with current inspection status.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a clear list of which permits and inspections are done and which are still needed, so the work stays legal.
